basic_info.description: Prime location and an exclusive opportunity. This is a distinguished top-floor condo residence featuring 3 beds, 2 baths in an intimate two-unit building, showcasing striking architectural lines in its interior. The grand living room features soaring 23-foot vaulted ceilings and a wood-burning fireplace. Abundant natural light floods the space through skylights and windows. The main floor includes the primary suite. Enjoy breathtaking Pacific Heights skyline views from the upstairs deck and glimpses of the Golden Gate Bridge, and one deeded garage parking spot. A short stroll provides access to the lovely S.F Bay Aquatic Park, Fort Mason Center, and Moscone Park. You're perfectly situated to explore the fantastic restaurants, stores, and artisanal coffee spots throughout the lively Marina District.  This home seamlessly blends modern style with the charm of one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Don't miss this opportunity to own a piece of Cow Hollow's unique allure.
